newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct household spending seen not too bad - govt.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct household spending seen not too bad - govt.

text.p: Japan's household spending is unlikely to be all that bad in October, an official of the government's Management and Coordination Agency said on Thursday.
The agency earlier announced that household spending in September fell 4.4 percent in real terms from a year earlier.
"Individual consumption in general remains in a recovery trend and the spending in October is unlikely to be all that bad," the official told reporters.
The drop in September was mainly due to sluggish sales of durable goods, such as airconditioners and summer clothing, as a result of unusually low temperatures that month.
